description: T1) Holm Oak: Reduce width by up to 1.5m to provide clearance from adjacent buildings; reduce height by up to 1m back to previous reduction points. G2) Row of Pleached Lime trees: Reduce height by up to 2 metres; trim sides by up to 1.5 metres.T3) Sycamore: Reduce overall crown by up to 2 metres within most recent reduction framework.T5) Ash: Reduce overall crown by up to 1.5 metres within most recent reduction framework.T6) Pagoda: Reduce overall crown by up to 1.5 metres within most recent reduction framework.T7) Catalpa: Reduce overall crown by up to 1.5 metres within most recent reduction framework.T8) Mulberry: Reduce overall crown by up to 1 metre within most recent reduction framework.T9) Apple in central garden area: Reduce overall crown by up to 1 metre within most recent reduction framework.(T4 Moved to 2025/02444/TREE as outside location of this notification - T4) Plane in neighbouring park: lift lower branches by up to 1 metre over garden side only to provide clearance from the boundary net. )
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
